lore.archery_gimmicks.light_bow: A fast-drawing ranged weapon that can be used to shoot nearby targets.
lore.archery_gimmicks.heavy_bow: A slow-drawing ranged weapon that can be used to shoot very far off targets.
lore.archery_gimmicks.weighted_arrow: An arrow that drops faster and launches the user backwards when shot.
entity.archery_gimmicks.weighted_arrow.d: A projectile fired from a Bow or Crossbow that can be picked up once grounded.
lore.archery_gimmicks.signal_arrow: An arrow that can be shot into the sky to create a glowing spot.
entity.archery_gimmicks.signal_arrow.des: A projectile fired from a Bow or Crossbow. If its signal was not activated, it can be picked up once grounded.
lore.archery_gimmicks.messenger_arrow: An arrow that can store items for quick transport when shot.
A projectile fired from a Bow or Crossbow that can be picked up once grounded. More items may be stored within the arrow.
lore.archery_gimmicks.tnt_arrow: An arrow that will explode on impact if it hits with high speed.
entity.archery_gimmicks.tnt_arrow.descri: A projectile fired from a Bow or Crossbow that can be picked up once grounded. If it hits with high speed, it will explode.
lore.archery_gimmicks.enchanted_arrow: An arrow that shot can be shot to call down an Ancient Arrow from the stars. It's an uncommon find.
A projectile fired from a Bow or Crossbow that will fizzle out once grounded. An omen of an Ancient Arrow yet to fall.
entity.archery_gimmicks.ancient_arrow.de: A projectile fallen from the stars above. Called down by an Enchanted Arrow.
enchantment.archery_gimmicks.quickstep.d: An enchantment that allows you to quickly dash backwards when you swing a bow.
